input.prompt: Use the supplied approved Loopforge references as the design authority. Isolate ONLY the specified single prop, not the whole room. Industrial soot-dark cast iron and aged muted brass, directional wear at edges, calm matte surfaces; no generic futuristic box. One coherent three-quarter product view, entire object visible, slight elevated camera so functional openings and work surfaces can be inspected. Neutral diffuse white illumination with no colored scene lighting baked into materials. Transparent background, no floor shadow or stand. No robots, people, labels, letters, numbers, symbols, lights, effects, floor or wall slabs, extra props or exploded/multiple views. Exactly one EMPTY open-top shallow industrial storage crate. Battered dark-iron rectangular body, thick rolled rim, riveted corner braces, restrained worn brass corner straps, two sturdy opposing side handles with open grip clearance, and a visible slatted drainage base. Show the entire empty interior from above in three-quarter view. Make this a practical carryable crate, not a sealed science-fiction cargo box. No lid, internal divider, lining, brain, tissue, cargo, robot, writing, wheels or surrounding machine. Preserve a broad flat bottom and readable side-handle silhouette.

note: Studio design brief adapted to built-in image generation; image reviewed before Meshy submission. Meshy image-generation stage omitted; costs recorded only in canonical Meshy ledger.
